name: SQUARE_CLIENT_ID
label: Square application ID
setupSteps: In the Square Developer Console, create an application (or open an existing one).
Under OAuth, add the redirect URL below for the Production environment (use the Sandbox tab and a sandbox- application ID to test against Square's sandbox).

Under Webhooks > Subscriptions, add a subscription with the notification URL {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/gatekeeper/retail/webhooks/square for the order, payment, refund, customer, catalog and inventory events.
Copy the Application ID, the Application secret and the subscription's signature key here.
